name: Music scores (LilyPond)
description: Write, check and play sheet music in LilyPond. Check compiles the score and lists errors and warnings as file(line,col), with bar-check failures (a bar with the wrong number of beats) called out; Build PDF engraves it; MIDI, PNG and Play (WAV or MP3, through TiMidity++) give the other outputs; Update syntax brings an old file to the installed LilyPond with convert-ly; MusicXML to LilyPond and ABC to LilyPond import scores from MuseScore, Finale, Sibelius and ABC tune books; New tune scaffolds a lead sheet. SAFETY: a LilyPond file can contain code that runs commands, and LilyPond's own safe mode was removed because it could not be made safe, so every run happens inside bubblewrap (no network, no home folder, read-only system, only a scratch copy writable); without bwrap the tool refuses to run LilyPond. The original is never changed.

packages.apt: lilypond bubblewrap timidity fluid-soundfont-gm php-cli ffmpeg

presets.label: Check (errors, warnings, bar checks)
presets.description: Compiles the score in a sandbox and reports every error and warning as file(line,col), with Fix with agent. A "barcheck failed" warning means the bar before that point has the wrong number of beats.

presets.label: Build the PDF
presets.description: Engraves the score as a PDF (in a sandbox, in a scratch copy: your folder gets no extra files).

presets.label: MIDI file
presets.description: The score's MIDI file (the score needs a \midi { } block inside \score { }).

presets.label: Play: the score as audio (MP3)
presets.description: The score played through TiMidity++ and its sound font, as an MP3 (needs a \midi block).

presets.label: First page as a picture (PNG)
presets.description: Page 1 of the engraved score as a PNG.

presets.label: Update the syntax (convert-ly)
presets.description: Brings an old .ly file to the syntax of the installed LilyPond and writes it as a new file.

presets.label: MusicXML to LilyPond
presets.description: Converts a MusicXML file (exported from MuseScore, Finale, Sibelius ...) to a .ly file. Run Check on the result: converted files often need a bar or a repeat fixed.

presets.label: ABC notation to LilyPond
presets.description: Converts an ABC tune file to a .ly file.

presets.label: New tune (lead sheet)
presets.description: Creates NAME.ly in the folder you give: a melody with chord names. Type the name in the extra arguments, then optionally key=d time=3/4 tempo=100. Never overwrites.
